title: Unlayered CSS reset was zeroing every padding/margin utility app-wide
goal: app/globals.css declared `* { box-sizing: border-box; padding: 0; margin: 0; }` as a plain, unlayered rule. Per the CSS cascade-layers spec, unlayered rules always beat layered ones, and every Tailwind utility (px-4, p-4, gap, mt-2, etc.) lives inside @layer utilities/base via `@import "tailwindcss"` — silently zeroing every padding/margin utility class app-wide, on every page, in both themes.
in_scope: Wrap the padding/margin reset in @layer base so it no longer unconditionally beats Tailwind spacing utilities
out_of_scope: Any other globals.css rule not part of this reset
acceptance: app/globals.css's `* { padding: 0; margin: 0; }` reset moved inside @layer base so it no longer unconditionally beats every Tailwind spacing utility; verified via computed-style inspection (MobileTopBar's px-4: 0px -> 16px) in both themes, and visually across Today/Add/Review/Insights/Catalog/Settings.
invariants: box-sizing: border-box reset itself must remain in effect app-wide
